subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent `tui.deliver` config key to set the default for `openclaw tui --deliver`, or keep TUI delivery as an explicit launch flag?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but repository policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product choices that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Approve a narrow config default
options.body: Add a documented `tui.deliver` boolean, keep explicit CLI flags authoritative, and cover default/config/override behavior with focused tests.

options.title: Keep flag-only behavior
options.body: Decline the new config surface and rely on `openclaw tui --deliver`, shell aliases, and the current docs now that the adjacent abort hang was fixed separately.

options.title: Choose a different TUI UX
options.body: Prefer an in-TUI setting, default flip, or another delivery model instead of adding an `openclaw.json` key.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow config default
recommendation.body: Add a documented `tui.deliver` boolean, keep explicit CLI flags authoritative, and cover default/config/override behavior with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the TUI flag behavior and has direct history on TUI CLI/config behavior, making this the best available routing candidate for the product/config choice.
